title: F07: Name normalisation, category lookup table + seed, duplicates
milestone: M4 Domain logic
labels: backend
---
## Goal
Normalise item names, categorise them by lookup, remember user choices and detect duplicate receipts.

**Depends on:** F02 (parallel with F03, F04)
**Built by:** `backend-dev`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Normaliser tests cover real receipt strings, e.g. `BIO BANANE 1 KG → banane` (qty 1, unit kg), and a fixed-size slow-regex guard
- [ ] Seed YAML is synced on startup (missing names inserted, `seed` rows updated, `user` rows untouched); every seed key is already normalised and every value a known category
- [ ] A category sent in `POST`/`PATCH /expenses` is saved to `item_categories` (source `user`) and used on the next receipt, with an API test (decision 0020)
- [ ] `/item-categories` GET/PUT/DELETE implemented per contract (DELETE of a user row restores the seed value; seed row → 409; unknown → 404)
- [ ] `possible_duplicate` (same normalised merchant, date, total ±0.01, any other expense) is tested in the domain, the pipeline and on edit
- [ ] No contract change: `docs/openapi.json` unchanged, `make check` green
